description.value: Valleycliffe General Store is a neighbourhood convenience store serving the Valleycliffe area of Squamish, a gateway community to world-class mountain biking and road cycling. As a general store in a residential district, it offers a local alternative to the larger grocery chains in central Squamish. Cyclists passing through or based in the area would find it a convenient stop for resupply.
